## Frequently asked questions

### Do I need a credit card to start the trial?

No, you can start your CloudTalk [free trial](https://www.cloudtalk.io/signup/) without a credit card.

### Can I switch plans at any time?

You can change your CloudTalk plan anytime directly from the dashboard.

Upgrades take effect immediately, while downgrades apply at the end of your current billing period (month/year). Keep in mind: CloudTalk bills in advance and doesn’t offer refunds or credits for partial months, unused time, or plan changes.

### Is there a minimum number of users required?

CloudTalk requires a minimum of one user for their basic plans, allowing small teams to get started easily. However, for the Expert plan, there is a minimum requirement of three users.

### Are there any setup or onboarding fees?

No, CloudTalk does not charge setup or onboarding fees.

### Do you offer volume or annual discounts?

Yes—when you pay annually, you save the equivalent of 3+ months (around 30% off).

### Is there a long-term commitment required?

CloudTalk doesn’t require long-term contracts for monthly plans—you can cancel or switch anytime. All plans are paid in advance. If you choose annual billing, you’ll receive a discounted rate, but it comes with a 12-month commitment.

### How do I cancel my subscription?

To [cancel](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/5591721-how-to-change-or-cancel-subscription), log in to your CloudTalk Dashboard, select your cancellation date and confirm. Once done, a cancellation notice will appear under your Current plan. **Keep in mind:** CloudTalk bills in advance and doesn’t offer refunds or credits for partial months or unused time.

### Is there a machine-readable version of this pricing?

Yes. Our [pricing.md](https://www.cloudtalk.io/pricing.md) file is a plain-text copy of this page for AI assistants and agents, generated from the same content, so it is never out of date.
